newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes up vs US dollar despite Deng's death.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes up vs US dollar despite Deng's death.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up at 8.2939 on Thursday from Wednesday's 8.2945 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai, despite the death of Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping.
Dealers said there was no intervention seen from the central bank.
The weighted average price on Wednesday was 8.2938.
Dealers said the news of Deng's death had little impact on the yuan's movement and prices would continued to move steadily around the current levels.
The yuan opened up at the 8.2940 level and consolidated around its highs for most of the session, hitting a low of 8.2967 early on.
Trading was active with most done at 8.2939, dealers said.
One dealer said Deng's death had little influence on the yuan's movement given the highly controlled nature of trading on the exchange.
"The yuan closed slightly down later in trading on Wednesday due to worries on Deng's health, so the market response on Deng's death was not so strong this morning," said a second dealer.
A third dealer said he expected the yuan to move around the 8.2940 level on Friday.
The yuan closed down at an intra-day low of 6.7125 from 6.7000 against 100 Japanese yen and slightly down at 1.0720 from 1.0716 against the Hong Kong dollar.
